name: HODIE Error Model v1
purpose: Represent learner errors consistently so HODIE can explain, prioritize, retry and route recovery.

severity.critical: Blocks the task or substantially changes meaning.
severity.high: Important error that should normally trigger targeted correction.
severity.medium: Useful correction but not a reason to interrupt fluent production.
severity.low: Minor form or style issue suitable for later review.

errorSchema.target: Specific language feature or communicative target.
errorSchema.contextId: Context in which the error occurred.

priorityRules: Prioritize errors that block task completion.
Prioritize errors that prevent the learner from expressing the Can-Do.
Prefer one or two high-value corrections over exhaustive correction.
Do not interrupt fluency practice for low-impact form errors.
A correction should lead to an action whenever retry is pedagogically useful.
